<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Check current state
seg = current_frame.segmentation
print(f"Step: {current_frame.step}, Level: {current_frame.level}")

print("\nObjects:")
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['pixels'] > 10:
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        print(f"  {n['color']}: pixels={n['pixels']} rows={min(rows)}-{max(rows)} cols={min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")

# Check dots
print("\nDots:")
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['pixels'] == 1:
        b = n['boundary'][0]
        print(f"  {n['color']} at ({b[0]}, {b[1]})")

# Try RIGHT to move things back
print("\nTrying RIGHT:")
for i in range(15):
    result = action(['RIGHT'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    c_objects = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'c']
    s_objects = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'S' and n['pixels'] > 50]
    if s_objects:
        s = s_objects[0]
        b = s['boundary']
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        divider_col = min(cols)
    else:
        divider_col = None
    print(f"RIGHT {i+1}: dark_gray={len(c_objects)}, divider_col={divider_col}")
    if result.get('level_completed'):
        print("LEVEL COMPLETED!")
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
